pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: I don’t remember locking the door
paragraphs: Fictional leaving-home card: person remembers switching off stove and unplugging iron; does not remember locking door or closing window. Friend has authorised spare key access. Learner asks the friend to check states and act only on a clear instruction. Plant-watering timing is undecided.

pages.title: What do you actually remember?
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’m on my way, but I don’t remember locking the door
lines.audioText: I’m on my way, but I don’t remember locking the door.
lines.translation: Estou a caminho, mas não me lembro de trancar a porta

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: You left a spare key with me. Would you like me to check?
lines.audioText: You left a spare key with me. Would you like me to check?
lines.translation: Você deixou uma chave reserva comigo. Quer que eu confira?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yes, please. I remember turning off the stove, but I was distracted at the door
lines.audioText: Yes, please. I remember turning off the stove, but I was distracted at the door.
lines.translation: Sim, por favor. Lembro de desligar o fogão, mas me distraí na porta

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Did you remember to unplug the iron as well?
lines.audioText: Did you remember to unplug the iron as well?
lines.translation: Você lembrou de tirar o ferro da tomada também?

questions.cue: Use the memories she actually states
questions.answer: Switching off the stove and unplugging the iron

pages.title: A specific checking request
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I did. I can picture putting it away. The window is less clear in my memory
lines.audioText: I did. I can picture putting it away. The window is less clear in my memory.
lines.translation: Sim. Consigo me lembrar de guardá-lo. A janela está menos clara na minha memória

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: All right. I’ll check the door and window, rather than assuming they’re open
lines.audioText: All right. I’ll check the door and window, rather than assuming they’re open.
lines.translation: Tudo bem. Vou conferir porta e janela em vez de presumir que estão abertas

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: If the window is open, please close it. The plants can stay where they are
lines.audioText: If the window is open, please close it. The plants can stay where they are.
lines.translation: Se a janela estiver aberta, feche, por favor. As plantas podem ficar onde estão

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Do you want me to water them while I’m there?
lines.audioText: Do you want me to water them while I’m there?
lines.translation: Quer que eu as regue quando estiver lá?

questions.prompt: What should happen if the window is open?

pages.title: Don’t assume the remaining instruction
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Let me think about the day first. I don’t want you to do it twice unnecessarily
lines.audioText: Let me think about the day first. I don’t want you to do it twice unnecessarily.
lines.translation: Deixe-me pensar no dia primeiro. Não quero que você faça duas vezes sem necessidade

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’ll send you a clear update after checking, and wait for that instruction
lines.audioText: I’ll send you a clear update after checking, and wait for that instruction.
lines.translation: Vou enviar uma atualização clara depois de conferir e esperar essa instrução

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Thanks. Please say what you’ve checked, not just that everything looks fine
lines.audioText: Thanks. Please say what you’ve checked, not just that everything looks fine.
lines.translation: Obrigada. Diga o que conferiu, não só que tudo parece bem

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Of course. Then we’ll know what’s done and what still needs a decision
lines.audioText: Of course. Then we’ll know what’s done and what still needs a decision.
lines.translation: Claro. Assim saberemos o que foi feito e o que ainda precisa de decisão

pages.title: Checked, done and still undecided
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. I’ve checked the flat. The door is locked, the stove is off, and the iron is unplugged. The window was open, so I’ve closed it as you asked. I haven’t watered the plants yet because you wanted to decide the timing first. Would you like me to water them today or come back on Saturday? I can do either. Please send that one instruction when you have a moment. Everything else on the list has been checked, so there’s no need to ask me to repeat the whole routine
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. I’ve checked the flat. The door is locked, the stove is off, and the iron is unplugged. The window was open, so I’ve closed it as you asked. I haven’t watered the plants yet because you wanted to decide the timing first. Would you like me to water them today or come back on Saturday? I can do either. Please send that one instruction when you have a moment. Everything else on the list has been checked, so there’s no need to ask me to repeat the whole routine.
